messages:
Maya (PM): quick post-launch check — we need to lock the next 2-week iteration plan for the Search Relevance rollout. customers are reporting both accuracy regressions and a few UI edge-case bugs. do we treat this as bug-first or mix with 1-2 enhancements?
Ajay (ENG): can we get counts? rough idea: severity and repro rate will drive it.
Maya (PM): from support: 18 tickets in the last 48h. 3 P1-ish (search returning empty for long queries), ~12 medium (ranking weirdness), 3 low UI polish. one strategic customer (Acme) flagged regression affecting key workflow.
Liam (SRE): if it's P1s hitting prod, we should prioritize rollbacks/canary fixes. what are the p99 latency impacts?
deploy-bot: :information_source: deployment 2026-03-22T14:12Z succeeded for search-service-v2
Sophie (PD): also consider cost to rework — some of the ranking anomalies look prompt-related (prompt template mismatch). could be a prompt or model slice.
Ajay (ENG): quick suggestion: triage into three buckets — hotfix (P1/P2 perf/regressions), rollback candidate (if model variant is root cause), and enhancement (UX/ranking tweaks). propose owners: hotfix -> Ajay, rollback evaluation -> Liam + infra, enhancements -> Sophie + Maya.
Maya (PM): sounds good. would like explicit criteria. can we codify? e.g., severity + user impact + rollback complexity + customer SLA exposure.
Ajay (ENG): draft rubric:

```
Criteria:   Severity | ActiveUsersAffected | ReproRate | SLAExposure | RollbackRisk
Action:     P1/P2   | >50                 | >10%      | High        | ImmediateFix or Rollback
P3         | <=50                | <10%      | Medium      | Schedule in sprint
P4         | cosmetic            | <1%       | Low         | Backlog
```

Maya (PM): nice. can we add a column for evaluation owner and ETA?
Ajay (ENG): sure — owner + 48h assessment for P1/P2, 5bd for P3, next groom for P4.
Liam (SRE): one caveat: rolling back the model variant will impact ongoing canary metrics. we need a short smoke and canary health checklist before rollback.
Sophie (PD): also recommend pairing each customer-facing fix with a quick regression test (prompt set) — we can run on Redwood Console to catch regressions.
Maya (PM): plan of action: 1) Ajay to triage the 3 P1s and estimate fix/rollback by EOD. 2) Liam to prepare canary rollback playbook + smoke checklist. 3) Sophie to assemble prompt regression set for Acme and top 5 search queries. 4) quick grooming Friday 10:30 PT to slot remaining medium items.
Ajay (ENG): ack — starting triage now. if fix is >2d, we'll flag rollback.
Liam (SRE): ack — will ping infra and prep rollback runbook. include the following checks: TTL, KV cache warm, prefix caching invalidation, and latency p95/p99 baseline.
Sophie (PD): I'll export top query sample and an initial evaluation script. can someone add a small test job to Redwood Optimize to compare v1 vs v2?
Maya (PM): Ajay, can you create PRD-lite for each hotfix (one-pager with cause, owner, ETA, rollback plan) and ping this thread when done?
Ajay (ENG): yep — I'll create the PRD-lite and link.
deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: scheduled canary rollout pause if error rate > 2% for 5m.
Maya (PM): thanks. if any new P1s come in tag #postlaunch-hot and @Maya. we'll reconvene after triage. :thumbsup:
file_note: Post-launch search relevance triage thread: triage rubric + owners + immediate actions
